newsitem.title: USA: US Southern Baptists boycott "gay friendly" Disney.
newsitem.headline: US Southern Baptists boycott "gay friendly" Disney.

text.p: The Southern Baptist Convention, the country's largest Protestant denomination, on Wednesday launched a boycott against Walt Disney Co. and its subsidiaries because of what it said were Disney's "gay-friendly" policies.

An overwhelming majority of delegates to the Southern Baptists' annual meeting approved a resolution calling on all 15.7 million members to boycott Disney and all its subsidiaries, including ABC television.

Disney has drawn the anger of Southern Baptists and other conservative religious groups because it offers health benefits to the partners of its homosexual employees and has allowed "Gay Days" organised by gay rights groups at its theme parks.

Southern Baptists warned last June they would give Disney one year to respond to their objections but its leaders said this week that the multibillion dollar company simply increased its "anti-family, pro-gay" policies and programming.

The final straw for Disney's critics came earlier this year when actress Ellen DeGeneres and the character she plays in "Ellen", a popular sitcom on Disney-owned ABC television, announced they were lesbians.

The resolution passed on Wednesday called on all Southern Baptists "to take the stewardship of their time, money and resources so seriously that they refrain from patronising The Disney Company and any of its related entities".
